name: Moonshot Kimi Chat Model
category_description: AI cluster sub-node (model, memory, tool, parser)
description: Use the Moonshot Kimi Chat Model node to send chat requests to the Kimi chat API and generate conversational responses. Use it when you need an AI chat model in a workflow. For example, you can power assistants, build multi-step AI chains, or produce model-driven content with tunable sampling and token settings

operations.description: (type: options, field: model): The model that generates the completion. Default: kimi-k2.5. Learn more at Moonshot Kimi Chat API docs
(type: number, field: frequencyPenalty): Positive values penalize new tokens based on their existing frequency, so the model repeats less. Default: 0
(type: number, field: maxTokens): The maximum number of tokens to generate in the completion. A value of -1 uses the model default. The token limit depends on the selected model. Default: -1
(type: options, field: responseFormat): Format of the model response. Default: text
(type: number, field: presencePenalty): Positive values penalize new tokens based on whether they appear in the text so far, increasing the model's likelihood to talk about new topics. Default: 0
(type: number, field: temperature): Controls randomness. Lower values make outputs less random; near zero the model becomes more deterministic. Default: 0.7
(type: number, field: timeout): Maximum time a request can take, in milliseconds. Default: 360000 (six minutes)
(type: number, field: maxRetries): Maximum number of retries to attempt for failed requests. Default: two

(type: number, field: topP): Nucleus sampling parameter controlling diversity. A value of zero point five means the model considers half of the likelihood-weighted options. We recommend changing either Top P or Sampling Temperature, don't change both. Default: 1
